name: Jelly Crowd
description:
One plugin to rule them all! Jelly Crowd turns Jellyfin into a complete media request & discovery platform — with no third-party plugins required.

• Discovery catalog (TMDB): browse, filter and search movies & shows, with a release calendar of what's coming.
• Requests: users request titles; admins approve or auto-approve through a queue, with automatic fulfilment via Radarr/Sonarr, a webhook or a custom script.
• Per-user disk quotas: configurable, with an optional adaptive quota that rewards active viewers, and media expiry to free space.
• Reviews, ratings & problem reports, with admin moderation.
• Notifications: Discord, email, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, Slack or webhook.
• Branding: theme the whole interface — logo, favicon, colours, font, background, custom CSS and left-menu links.
• Statistics & dashboards: built-in playback stats for admins (top media & users, activity charts, live 'now playing') plus a personal dashboard for every user.

Entirely self-hosted by Jelly Crowd. For Jellyfin 10.11+.
overview: One plugin to rule them all — TMDB catalog, media requests, per-user quotas, branding and stats, inside Jellyfin.
